name: @flowforge/infrastructure-github-signals
description: FlowForge GitHub wait lifecycle domain — GitHubWaitLifecycleService, predicate catalog, baseline readers, wait state machine and renderer. Ported from clowder-ai `domains/github-signals` (B5 / C47). Self-contained: GitHub fetch / task-store / connector-delivery / event-log seams are injectable ports with in-memory contract implementations. Decoupled from real GitHub API, host task stores and connector delivery wiring.
